Name: Dotonbori
Tip: Come at dusk and take small portions at several stalls instead of one big meal.

Name: Kuromon Market
Tip: Come before 10 a.m. and bring cash for small tasting portions.

Name: Osaka Castle
Tip: Come in the morning when it is still cool and empty, and plan time for the park.

Name: Shinsekai & Tsutenkaku Tower
Tip: Eat kushikatsu and follow the “no double dipping” rule.

Name: Umeda Sky Building & Floating Garden
Tip: Come shortly before sunset and stay until the lights come on.

Name: Shinsaibashi & Amerikamura
Tip: Come in the afternoon and combine the stroll with Dotonbori in the evening.

Name: Hōzenji Yokochō – the lane behind Dotonbori
Tip: Come after dinner and enjoy the calm after the bustle.

Name: Nakazakichō – retro cafés in old houses
Tip: Come in the afternoon and check the opening times of the small shops.

Name: Namba Yasaka Shrine – the lion’s head
Tip: Go early in the morning or late in the afternoon when it is quiet.

Name: Nara – temples & tame deer
Tip: Go early before the groups arrive and keep food out of your bag.
